children: Greenlane appointed Bruce Linton as chair of the Audit Committee and added William Levy and Jonathan Ip to key board committees following two director resignations.
Michael Howe and Donald Hunter resigned from the board and all committees effective August 31, 2026, prompting committee changes.
Bruce Linton named chair of the Audit Committee; Audit Committee now comprises Linton, William Levy and Jonathan Ip.
Board determined Linton, Levy and Ip meet Nasdaq and SEC independence standards; Linton also qualifies as an audit committee financial expert.
William Levy and Jonathan Ip appointed to the Compensation Committee, with Levy designated as chair, effective after resignations.
